Regional Councils are formed to address specific issues affecting multiple states.

items: Note that Regional Councils are temporary bodies, not permanent standing institutions.
Focus on their core objective: handling specific multi-state issues as needed.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Regional Councils address specific issues impacting multiple states.
They operate as temporary bodies rather than permanent structures.
They are created dynamically on an as-needed basis.
